 HADA Labo Tokyo has entered the sun care category with the launch of four new SPF 50 and SPF 50 sunscreens. 
 Developed by Mentholatum Australasia to meet the strict requirements of the Therapeutic Goods Administration, each product was designed specifically for Australian conditions. 
 Newly launched is the SPF 50 Hydrating Face Fluid Sunscreen (RRP $34.95), a lightweight formula that leaves a glowy finish. 
 Other products in the range include the SPF 50 Hydrating Face Sunscreen that offers a matte, anti-shine finish (RRP $39.95), the SPF 50 Hydrating Tinted Face Sunscreen for sheer coverage (RRP $39.95), and SPF 50 Hydrating Sunscreen. 
 “We didn’t just import a Japanese formula, our team developed this range in Australia to meet those requirements, while protecting everything people love about Japanese SPF and Hada Labo Tokyo, featherlight textures and serious hydration,” explained Dominique Ries, head of marketing at Mentholatum Australasia.
